name: fold-pre-edit-of-a-dot-slash-spelling-meets-the-holder-on-every-disk
description: Session A takes EXCLUSIVE on data/x.txt; session B then pre-edits ./data/x.txt. Dropping a ./ segment is tidying, which every profile does, none included, so on every disk B meets A's hold with the collision warning, which echoes ./data/x.txt as B sent it. One expectation for every profile. Both backends.
